title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1993-09-29
lineage: MAD > Sony TCD-D10P > SPDIF > Audiophile 2496 > Soundforge (at 48kHz) > CD-Wave > R8Brain v1.9 (downsample to 44.1kHz) > TLH > FLAC.
source: Nakamichi CM-300's w/CP-4 shotgun capsules > Casio DA-7 > Sony DT-Dat tape. Mics on 7-foot stand, pointed at stacks, floor taping section, aprx 2 or 3 rows behind soundboard.

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard capture of a classic Terrapin Station sequence with clear audio and strong show flow
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the performance, especially the Terrapin Station → Drums → Space → Playing in the Band (reprise) suite, calling it an all‑time great. The recording is described as far superior to the original audience tape, indicating a clean soundboard source with no noticeable flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it is highly positive about both the musical performance and the audio quality, warranting a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes that this recording clears up doubts caused by a poor audience tape; no specific flaws mentioned, implying clear and balanced sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The Terrapin Station suite flowing into Drums, Space and a Playing in the Band reprise is highlighted as a seamless, high‑energy sequence.
